parts.text:
{
  "conversations": [
    {
      "title": "Rent a surfboard",
      "lines": [
        { "speaker": "you", "text": "Do you rent surfboards?" },
        { "speaker": "partner", "text": "Yeah, what size do you need?" },
        { "speaker": "you", "text": "I need a longboard, please." },
        { "speaker": "you", "text": "I need a shortboard, please.", "or": true },
        { "speaker": "partner", "text": "How many days?" },
        { "speaker": "you", "text": "Just for today." },
        { "speaker": "you", "text": "For three days, please.", "or": true }
      ],
      "vocab": [
        "rent",
        "surfboard",
        "size",
        "longboard",
        "shortboard",
        "day"
      ]
    },
    {
      "title": "Ask about wave conditions",
      "lines": [
        { "speaker": "you", "text": "How are the waves today?" },
        { "speaker": "partner", "text": "They're pretty small right now." },
        { "speaker": "partner", "text": "They're really big right now.", "or": true },
        { "speaker": "you", "text": "When is high tide?" },
        { "speaker": "partner", "text": "Around noon." },
        { "speaker": "you", "text": "Which beach is best for beginners?" },
        { "speaker": "partner", "text": "Check out the north side." }
      ],
      "vocab": [
        "wave",
        "condition",
        "tide",
        "beach",
        "small",
        "big"
      ]
    },
    {
      "title": "Get local food recommendations",
      "lines": [
        { "speaker": "you", "text": "Where's a good place to eat near here?" },
        { "speaker": "partner", "text": "Do you want local food or burgers?" },
        { "speaker": "you", "text": "I want local food." },
        { "speaker": "you", "text": "I'd like a burger, please.", "or": true },
        { "speaker": "partner", "text": "Try the soda down the street." },
        { "speaker": "you", "text": "What's good there?" },
        { "speaker": "partner", "text": "The fish is always fresh." }
      ],
      "vocab": [
        "eat",
        "food",
        "local",
        "street",
        "fish",
        "fresh"
      ]
    }
  ]
}
